rules.description: Visual-backend behavior rules for this scene: trigger -> optional conditions -> action(s). Compiled to deterministic C in ui_design.c and executed by the firmware logic service.

navrh.description: Merena data z artboardu (most tabos-ui-kit -> ESPOS): vyhrazene pasy (razitko/hlavicka/navigace), rodicovske ramecky prvku, smaltove plochy, delici cary, sirky zmerene SKUTECNYM fontem v prohlizeci, skalu rezu, paletu a soustavu odsazeni. Nese je scena, ne widget: widget ma additionalProperties:false a je obousmerne svazany s ui_models.WidgetConfig, kdezto scena ma additionalProperties:true. Tvar je tu POPSANY, ale zamerne nevynucovany - o vadny blok se stara tools/validate_design.py (znacka 'vadny blok navrh'), aby tentyz preklep nehlasila dve mista.

pasy.description: Vyhrazene pasy sceny: jmeno -> [x, y, sirka, vyska]. Pas ZAKLADA prvek, ktery nese data-pas i data-pas-vyska (razitko, hlavicka, navigace); kdo nese jen data-pas, je jeho CLEN a smi v nem lezet - ale cely (Rule 136).

prvky.description: _widget_id -> {rodic: [x, y, sirka, vyska], rodic_id, pas, role, sirka_textu, sirka_bunky, prazdne, presah, vec, orez, font_size, tucne, enabled, inkoust, podklad, vsazka}. rodic_id je _widget_id nejblizsiho predka, ktery je taky ve scene - jim se Rule 138 pta na POTOMKY misto na pouhy prekryv. orez je JEDNO mereni o ctyrech cislech (sirka_obsahu, sirka_schranky, vyska_obsahu, vyska_schranky = scrollWidth/clientWidth a jejich svisle protejsky); Rule 144 a 145 z nej ctou, jestli schranka text SKUTECNE useknula - to je jina velicina nez DEKLAROVANA bunka Rule 137. font_size nese Rule 148 (skala) i Rule 149 (uhlova velikost). inkoust a podklad jsou VIDENA dvojice barev (uz se slozenou prusvitnosti a opacity) pro Rule 17; scenove color_fg/color_bg zustavaji barvou, kterou generator NAPSAL, protoze na ni se pta Rule 150. tucne a enabled jsou druha pulka meze velkeho textu a vyjimka WCAG 1.4.3. vsazka je vlastni odsazeni bloku pro Rule 151 - PARAMETR meze, ne vypinac pravidla.

slovnik.description: Vec -> povolene stavy, ktere o ni smi listy rikat.

druh.description: Druh listu: obrazovka (co bude na skle pristroje) nebo vyklad o navrhu (rozvrzeni ramce, slovnik smaltu, stavova karta). Rule 142 (jazykovy zakon F4) meri jen obrazovky - vyklad vadu CITUJE. Chybejici klic = obrazovka.

jmena_sdk.description: Jmena rozhrani a hodnot enumu z hlavicek SDK (validate_design.jmena_ze_sdk). Rule 142 jimi rozhoduje o verzalkovem slove uvnitr vety: seznam se NEOPISUJE, vozi ho most z pinnutych hlavicek jadra.

plochy.description: Jmena prvku, ktere JSOU smaltova plocha (svetle pole nesouci tmavy inkoust). Rule 146 jimi meri polaritu: text lezici na plose, ktery neni jejim potomkem, se kresli barvou tmave strany. Nesou se JMENA, ne obdelniky - obdelnik uz scena ma, prislusnost ne.

cary.description: Delici cary listu jako obdelniky [x, y, sirka, vyska]. Vlasova linka (1 px) do sceny nevstupuje - most zahazuje vsechno tenci nez 2 px - takze Rule 147 (cara pres text) potrebuje vlastni nosic.

skala.description: Zavazna skala rezu pisma a JMENOVITE vyjimky tohohle listu: {rezy: [14, 16, 20, 24, 32], vyjimky: {"40": "veta proc"}}. Rule 148 jimi meri, jestli list sazi pet roli, nebo si prisadil sesty rez. Vyjimka bez vety je jen vypinac pravidla a zahazuje se nahlas. Rezy vozi most z tokens.json (typography), vyjimky z typografie_vyjimky - obojí odtud, aby skala nemela sestou kopii.

paleta.description: Barvy, ze kterych se list smi kreslit (kit vozi tokens.json colors, tedy tutez paletu, kterou ma firmware v tema.h). Rule 150 jimi meri color_fg a color_bg kazdeho viditelneho prvku a hlasi kazdou RUZNOU barvu jednou s poctem prvku.

paleta_vlastni.description: Veta o tom, ze CELY list ma vlastni identitu (list v negativu, zamerne stara obrazovka). Rule 150 pak vyda jeden WARN s duvodem misto vyctu barev. Prazdne oznaceni je vypinac bez duvodu a zahazuje se.

soustava.description: Soustava odsazeni: {pole_x, vsazka} z tokens.json layout (obsah.x a ram.vsazka). Rule 151 jimi meri text, ktery zacina MEZI hranou pole a zavaznou vsazkou, tedy se lepi na ram. Blok s vlastni vsazkou (prvky[*].vsazka) se meri proti sve, ne proti teto.

style.description: Widget style. Simple tokens (default, bold, inverse, highlight) or space-separated combos (e.g. 'bold highlight'). Charts may use 'bar' or 'line'.

runtime.description: Semicolon-separated key=value pairs for firmware runtime bindings (e.g. 'bind=contrast;kind=int;min=0;max=255'). Empty string means no binding.

items.description: List widget entries. This is the canonical key emitted by WidgetConfig save (asdict). Always present on every widget (default []).

list_items.description: Legacy/external read-side alias for `items` (alternative to newline-separated text). Normalized into WidgetConfig.items on load; never emitted by save.

locked.description: Prevent editing this widget in the designer.

theme_fg_role.description: Theme role binding for foreground color.

theme_bg_role.description: Theme role binding for background color.

state.description: Current state variant (default, pressed, disabled, etc.).

state_overrides.description: Per-state property overrides. Keys are state names, values are property dicts.

corner_radius.description: Corner radius for rounded widgets (null = sharp corners).

events.description: Visual-backend event handlers for this widget. Each handler key maps to a list of actions run when the event fires on the firmware. The widget must have an 'id'/'_widget_id' for its events to be wired.

on_press.description: Actions run when this widget is activated (A button / encoder press / toggle).

on_change.description: Actions run when this widget's value/checked state changes (slider/checkbox/toggle/list).

on_focus.description: Actions run when this widget receives focus.

rule.description: A scene rule: when 'trigger' fires and all 'conditions' hold, run 'actions' in order.

name.description: Optional human label (for the designer / generated C comment).

conditions.description: Optional AND/OR list of boolean conditions; all must hold (subject to op) for actions to run.

timer_id.description: timer: which logic timer slot (0..15) firing this rule.

pin.description: gpio_in: GPIO number whose level change fires this rule.

widget.description: widget: id of the widget whose event fires this rule.

event.description: widget: which widget event fires this rule.

action.description: One real, codegen-backed effect. Every type compiles to working firmware C.

prop.description: set_widget: which widget property to set.

value.description: set_widget value, gpio level (0/1), timer ms, or var int expression depending on action.

expr.description: set_var: bounded integer expression over int vars / literals (e.g. 'counter + 1').

bytes.description: ble_send/lora_send: payload as a short ASCII/hex string (board must expose the radio peripheral).

condition.description: A boolean test on an int var or a widget value/checked state.

rhs.description: Right side: an integer literal, 'var:<name>', or a widget ref like lhs.

join.description: How this condition combines with the NEXT one in the list (default '&&').
